name: graph-jsonl-reader-hand-maintained-match
body: `read_graph_jsonl` is a hand-maintained per-record-type match ending in an `unknown type` bail, so every new `Export` variant needs its own arm or the shared read→write consistency path trips. Limit: the reader's type coverage is not derived from the writer's variant set, so a writer-only change compiles while the reader bails at runtime. Upgrade: derive the dispatch from the `Export` variants (or a shared table) if a second reader ever needs the same mapping.
